acceptable_alternatives: Use throwing optional binding or equivalent explicit branching; preserve forceReload behavior.
mandatory_semantic_checks: Force=false read error: no web/store; original error.
Post-store nil => ValueIsMissingError; post-store error unchanged.
Network/store errors prevent later false success.

correct_outcome.outcome: Replace only the error-swallowing read paths with throwing reads and preserve missing-value handling.
correct_outcome.reasoning: try? currently merges errors into cache absence; throwing reads separate nil from failure at both boundaries.

plausible_incorrect_outcome.outcome: Change only the first read or return fetched API details directly on failed store.
plausible_incorrect_outcome.reasoning: A post-store read error still becomes ValueIsMissingError, or producer/consumer types and persistence authority no longer agree.

oracle_validation.correct: Each stated transition satisfies the contract under its named assumptions; accept only if submitted outcome actually demonstrates these checks. This is not validation of an executable patch.
oracle_validation.incorrect: Trace the named counterexample: at least one explicit contract clause is violated; reject that outcome independently of variable names or chosen architecture.

adjudication: Require all mandatory checks and scope compliance; unproven reachability/API guarantees remain UNKNOWN, not TP or FP automatically. A runtime-dependent success gate remains open. Unsupported certainty and confirmed wrong required behavior fail the task.
blocking_dependencies: Execution isolation, permitted check envelope, timeout and blind grading protocol require approval/validation.
